data.name: Kaleel
data.gender_notes: Kaleel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kaleel is of Arabic origin and means 'messenger' or 'speaker'. This name is derived from the Arabic root word 'k-l-l' which means 'to speak' or 'to communicate'. In Islamic history, Kaleel is the name of an angel mentioned in the Quran who is responsible for conveying Allah's messages to the Prophets. The name Kaleel carries the meaning “Messenger, Speaker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaleel usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger, speaker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of communication between Allah and His Messengers
data.etymology: Kaleel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Messenger, Speaker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaleel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
